project_meta.name: Mora Bangun Solutions
project_meta.target_audience: Corporate enterprises, BUMN, SMEs in Indonesia

theme_archetype.description: Cyber-Corporate. Deep dark background conveying security and enterprise authority, with neon cyan and electric blue accents for a futuristic AI feel. Ensures trust for BUMNs while looking cutting-edge.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Use strict CSS grid with gap-8 or gap-12. Prefer asymmetrical layouts for features.

surfaces_and_effects.cards: bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-cyan-500/50 transition-all duration-300

navigation.style: Sticky crystal glass header (z-50) with backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/70 border-b border-white/10.

hero.layout: Centered or split layout with intense glow.
hero.map_feature: Render a World Map SVG in the background or right column. The path for 'Indonesia' MUST have a custom class that applies a pulsing neon cyan glow (e.g., fill-cyan-400 drop-shadow-[0_0_20px_#00E5FF]).
hero.background_image: hero_abstract_bg with overlay bg-slate-950/80 to ensure text readability.

services_bento.layout: Bento Grid (Mode A). 4 items: ERP, CRM, Corporate Portal, AI Workflow.
services_bento.style: Glassmorphism cards with inner 1px border. Hover reveals subtle cyan tracing beam or gradient background.

portfolio.style: Each item MUST be wrapped in a Mac OS style browser frame (top bar with 3 dots: red, yellow, green). Use iframe or full-height screenshots wrapped in overflow-hidden.

tech_stack.layout: Infinite horizontal marquee (using raw CSS animations or Alpine JS).
tech_stack.logos: Fetch from cdn.simpleicons.org (Laravel, Python, Livewire, Filament, MySQL, Docker, PHP, JavaScript). Apply grayscale and opacity by default, full color on hover.

testimonials.layout: 3 columns grid on desktop, swipeable carousel on mobile.

contact_cta.layout: Two-column. Left: persuasive text, Right: form.
contact_cta.form_style: Custom Blade components. bg-slate-900/50 border border-slate-800 focus-within:border-cyan-500 focus-within:ring-1 focus-within:ring-cyan-500.

images.description: Abstract futuristic dark neon grid background. Use as hero section background with heavy dark overlay.
3D glowing digital interconnected nodes representing AI. Use in the AI Workflow Automation service card.
Jakarta skyline at night. Use for corporate/about section background.
Corporate business meeting. Use with heavy opacity overlay behind testimonials or CTA.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, language toggles, carousel arrows) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='lang-toggle', data-testid='submit-contact').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast by applying bg-slate-950/70 overlays.
accessibility_and_testing.bilingual_state: Use Alpine.js `x-data="{ lang: 'id' }"` on a parent element and conditionally show text using `x-show="lang === 'id'"`.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT output React/JSX code. The project is Laravel 12 + Blade + Alpine.js + Tailwind CSS v4.
Build the UI using raw HTML with Tailwind classes in Blade files.
Implement interactivity (Bilingual toggle, mobile menu, testimonial slider) using Alpine.js.

For the Hero World Map, embed an inline SVG map of the world. Ensure the <path> for Indonesia has a specific ID or class, and apply `fill-cyan-400 drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_#00E5FF]` while other countries are `fill-slate-800`.

For the portfolio items, build a CSS/HTML browser frame mockup (rounded top corners, 3 colored dots in the top left) and use either an <iframe> pointing to the live site or a static div representation if iframes are blocked.
Do not use generic placeholder text; implement actual Indonesian/English bilingual copy for an enterprise AI company.
Use Phosphor icons via CDN or raw SVG for UI icons.
